meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **₹500 ke andar oily skin ke liye meri first choice Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Cleanser** hogi. Current listings mein ye roughly **₹269–₹299** ke aas-paas mil raha hai, aur salicylic acid excess oil aur clogged pores ko target karta hai. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/face-wash-under-500-for-daily-cleansing-from-cetaphil-minimalist-to-mamaearth-10914029?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Short answer:**  
- Pimples/blackheads bhi hain → **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid**
- Sirf oily skin hai, pimples nahi → **Simple Refreshing Facial Wash**
- Skin sensitive hai → **Simple** se start karna better.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **oily skin ke saath pimples/blackheads hain ya sirf oiliness**, main ₹500 ke andar **1 best face wash + moisturizer + sunscreen** ka combo bhi suggest kar sakta hoon.
